definitions.search:
T40 F (v2, analytic, lead rule 2026-10-03): hurdle placement on the recorded transport path. CPU, 1 process per call.
usage: fsearch.py TAG [TAG ...]  -> raw/fsearch_<TAG>.json

Path      : recorded apple-centre path (free-joint qpos 38:41) over control rows lift_t <= t < place_t of E0 and of E3b (T40 A
            windows), resampled every 0.01 m of 3-D arc length s from lift-off.
Candidate : bar centre xy = path point at s (run R in {E0, E3b}); bar direction = horizontal path normal (tangent from the xy
            path +-3 cm of arc; where the xy tangent is < 5 mm over that span, i.e. the vertical lift, the apple t0 -> crate
            direction is used) rotated by dyaw in {0, +-20, +-40} deg; extension (not in the lead's rule, flagged): the bar centre
            may be shifted along the bar by u in {-0.06, 0, +0.06} m (the path still crosses the bar between the posts);
            bar_height h in {0.20, 0.22, ..., 0.32} m.
Order     : a -> b -> d -> c, each with an early-exit scan (flib.first_le0; same distance code); survivors get full minima.
Checks    : (a) client reset check on the captured reset scene (flib: robot_clearance > 0, object_clearance > 0);
            (c) exact, min over lift_t <= t < place_t of min(gripper, apple) distance <= 0 in E0 AND E3b; also c at h - 0.02
                (geometric only, flag c_low);
            (d) min over rows t < lift_t of distance to all robot geoms, apple, other fruits > 0 (both runs);
            (b) t0 (recorded planning row 0) robot, apple+fruits, crate > 0 (both runs).
Detour (e): for each distinct feasible bar-centre xy: kinematic max left-TCP z at that xy (workspace.max_tcp_z: SLSQP over the
            7 left-arm joints, xy tol 5 mm, approach axis within 15 deg of the recorded carry axis, no collision check) per run,
            max over runs; apple_bottom_max_est = that - median(TCP z - apple bottom z) over the carry rows of both runs;
            free_height_over_bar = apple_bottom_max_est - bar top (h + 0.012).
Selection : tier 1 = feasible and c_low and reset robot >= 0.02 and reset object >= 0.01 and pre-lift >= 0.02 and t0 >= 0.02;
            tier 2 = feasible and c_low; tier 3 = feasible. Within the best non-empty tier: largest free_height_over_bar,
            ties -> larger pre-lift minimum.
definitions.selection:
T40 F step 2: choose one placement per episode from raw/fsearch_<TAG>[ _u10].json, write the config, cross-check.
usage: select_write.py TAG [TAG ...]  -> configs/t40f_ep<EP>_s<SEED>_r1.json, raw/select_<TAG>.json

Margins m = min(reset robot clearance, reset object clearance, pre-lift minimum (robot+apple+fruits, both runs), t0 minimum).
Tiers (no candidate of any episode reached the lead's 20 mm, so the thresholds are 10 and 5 mm):
  T1: c_low (still blocks with the bar 20 mm lower) and m >= 0.010;  T2: c_low and m >= 0.005;  T3: c_low;  T4: feasible.
Within the best non-empty tier: largest free_height_over_bar (detour room, fsearch definition), ties -> larger m.
Pool = fsearch_<TAG>.json (u in {0, +-0.06}) plus fsearch_<TAG>_u10.json (u in {+-0.08, +-0.10}) when present.
Cross-check of the chosen placement: (1) GJK (gjk.signed_dist) at the argmin row/pair of each reported minimum vs the client
distance; (2) the client's own reset check: dryrun.py (snapshot pi05_infer.main() up to the policy call).

D_round2.selection:
T40 D: one adjustment round (round 2) for the episodes whose E3b run failed with the round-1 hurdle. CPU.
usage: dselect.py TAG [TAG ...]  -> configs/t40f_ep<EP>_s<SEED>_r2.json, raw/dselect_<TAG>.json

Every round-1 E3b failure was an obstacle stop BEFORE lift-off (gripper/finger <-> bar during the approach, or the 1995 stop with
clearance 0.0 and no contact); so round 2 keeps (a)-(d) and (c) from the same F pool (fsearch_<TAG>[ _u10].json: bar centre on the
recorded T39 path, blocks both recorded transports) and maximises the pre-lift room, now also against the round-1 closed-loop
approaches:
  m_T39 = min(reset robot, reset object, T39 pre-lift minimum, t0 minimum)            (F numbers)
  m_C   = min over the round-1 C runs (E0 and E3b) of the hurdle <-> ROBOT_ALL distance over every recorded control row before
          that run's lift-off (or before its end when it never lifted), client distance code (cap 0.05)
  score = min(m_T39, m_C); choose the max score; ties -> lower bar_height. The round-1 placement is excluded.
The chosen placement is re-checked: GJK at the argmins (select_write.gjk_check) and the client dry run (dryrun.py).
